messages:
emma: Thinking of running a 'Hot Cocoa Lab + Cookie Swap' in the pantry next Tue. People bring a dozen cookies (or store-bought) and one mug for a cocoa bar. Also a small station for decorating cookies. :hot_cocoa: :cookie:
nate: love. dosing options for cocoa? dairy, oat, and almond? and sugar-free syrup?
riley: yes to multiple milk options. i'll bring cocoa powder + cinnamon sticks.
jess: i'll handle gluten-free cookies and label them. also can do gluten-free sprinkles for decorating. :sparkles:
morgan: can Facilities unlock the pantry for an hour and confirm there is a power strip for the cocoa urn? @facilities
facilities: @morgan confirmed. Pantry door access updated for Tue 12:00-13:30. We can provide one power strip but bring your own extension if you need more. Max 20 people in the pantry at once.
emma: thanks! quick time poll: 12:00 or 12:30? react with :one: for 12:00, :two: for 12:30.
nate: :two:
riley: :one: (leaning 12 for quick lunch)
jess: :two: works for me.
emma: going with 12:30 then. i'll create the calendar invite. please label cookies with allergens and whether they're homemade or store-bought.
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Hot Cocoa Lab + Cookie Swap" - Tue Jul 2 12:30-13:30 - RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/cocoa-cookie-222334
```
Invite: Hot Cocoa Lab + Cookie Swap
When: Tue Jul 2, 12:30-13:30
Where: Pantry (Floor 4)
Notes: Bring a dozen cookies to swap (or donate). Label allergens. Bring your own mug. Multiple milk options available. Max 20 people.
```
nate: i'll bring a small electric urn and a jar of sugar-free syrup. who can bring napkins and plates?
riley: me for napkins + disposable plates.
jess: i'll bring decorating kit (icing, piping bags, gf sprinkles).
emma: i'll make a tiny signup sheet for cookie types so we don't get 7 chocolate chip batches :grin: also i'll post a reminder Monday.
morgan: should we open it to partners? might be crowded. maybe keep it internal this time.
jess: internal sounds good. cozy event.
emar: (typo) meant 'morgan' +1 internal.
emma: noted. thanks everyone! see you Tue 12:30 for cocoa testing and cookie critique :cookie::hot_cocoa:
